sql: WITH admins AS (SELECT AdmFName1 AS first_name, District FROM schools WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT AdmFName2, District FROM schools WHERE AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT AdmFName3, District FROM schools WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL) SELECT first_name, COUNT(*) AS admin_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT District) AS districts FROM admins GROUP BY first_name ORDER BY admin_count DESC LIMIT 2;
